title: Mind the Gap! Pathways Towards Unifying AI Safety and Ethics Research
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion. It performs a bibliometric and network analysis of the AI safety and ethics research fields.
findings: This paper does not analyze aspects of religion; its findings relate to the structural divide between the AI safety and AI ethics research communities, showing high insularity and fragile connections between them.
references: Analyzing preprints: The challenges of working with metadata from arXiv's Quantitative Biology section, Nov. 2019.
